description: The bar chart presents an ablation study showing classification accuracy for six model variants on two datasets, with the left half labeled “PHEME” and the right half labeled “PolitiFact,” separated by a vertical dashed divider. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model conditions (slanted labels) in the same order for both datasets: “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick marks from 75.0 up to 95.0 in regular 2.5-point increments. In the PHEME section, the six single bars are colored consistently by condition: “Ours” (dark maroon) is labeled 89.84, “w/o comments” (orange) is 86.82, “w/o text” (light yellow) is 80.10, “w/o select” (very light blue/gray) is 88.80, “w/o emotion” (medium blue) is 87.34, and “w/o cognition” (dark blue) is 87.17, with values printed above each bar. In the PolitiFact section, the corresponding bars show “Ours” (dark maroon) at 90.57, “w/o comments” (orange) at 85.85, “w/o text” (light yellow) at 83.02, “w/o select” (very light blue/gray) at 89.62, “w/o emotion” (medium blue) at 84.91, and “w/o cognition” (dark blue) at 87.74, also annotated with their numeric values. The bars are not displayed in a visually sorted order by height; they follow the fixed ablation-condition order, and there is no additional legend beyond the repeated x-axis labels and consistent color usage.
